description: CCP beacon format test vectors. TDMA slots use (FNV-1a32(EUI64) + u32(SFN)) mod num_slots with basis 0x811c9dc5. The beacon header is the exact 24-byte unsigned big-endian layout from spec 02a section 2a.2. Also includes EMA fixed-point arithmetic edge cases.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_sfn_max_wraparound
vectors.description: TDMA slot at SFN=0xFFFFFFFF (max u32) - tests wraparound behavior
vectors.notes: Unsigned-32 addition wraps: (3236109245 + 4294967295) mod 2^32, then mod 16, equals 12.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_eui_one_baseline
vectors.description: Baseline slot for EUI64=0x0000000000000001 at SFN=0

vectors.name: tdma_slot_num_slots_8
vectors.description: Canonical modulus uses the advertised eight-slot schedule.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_num_slots_8_alt_eui
vectors.description: Eight-slot modulus with a second EUI-64.
vectors.notes: The canonical result is in the advertised range 0 through 7.

vectors.name: hash_32_fnv1a_single_byte
vectors.description: FNV-1a32 hash of single zero byte

vectors.name: ema_positive_samples
vectors.description: Language-neutral Q16.16 EMA with positive SNR samples and arithmetic shift by two.

output.notes: Each integer sample is converted to Q16.16 before avg += (sample - avg) >> 2.

vectors.name: ema_negative_samples
vectors.description: Language-neutral Q16.16 EMA with negative SNR samples; right shift is arithmetic (floor for negative integers).

output.notes: Arithmetic right shift is required for negative differences; logical shift is non-conformant.

vectors.name: beacon_header_layout
vectors.description: Exact 24-byte CCP beacon header field layout.
vectors.notes: Every multi-byte integer is unsigned big-endian. CBOR options and the 48-byte Schnorr signature follow this fixed header.

vectors.name: beacon_wire_example
vectors.description: Exact independently encoded beacon header example.

output.notes: epoch, SFN, timestamp, setup_window, occupied_time, and channel_mask are unsigned big-endian; guard is the normative 50 ms.
